vegetable_model.selection: lowest validation cross-entropy (trained on Train with Valid for selection; Test was scored once afterwards, experiments/watermark round 2)
vegetable_model.command: python src/train.py --watermark-fresh 0.6 --watermark-rotten 0.3 --watermark-style light --seed 42 --manifest dataset/manifest.csv --out OUT --arch efficientnet_b0 --num-classes 10 --mode finetune --epochs 30 --patience 8 --threads 4
